registry: NOVA SHA-X Extreme Research experiment registry
basis: Stage 0 source-level reconciliation against remote HEAD 18ff4eb070a066dec4424cf9cd4d8282fa9a38b3 plus the uncommitted Prompt 1 local delta. Status is one of NEW, UNDER_INVESTIGATION, EXPERIMENTAL, PROVEN, INTEGRATED, REJECTED, DEFERRED. INTEGRATED is used only where the current production path actually calls the result, verified in gpu/engine.py, mining/engine.py, mining/mainnet_live.py, mining/solo_server.py or mining/autopilot.py source.

entries.hypothesis: All production backends agree digest-for-digest and hit-for-hit with the hashlib reference at fuzzing scale, across random headers, boundary nonces, unaligned spans and target densities including the solo share density (portfolio NOVA-ER-0007, register X-096)
entries.baseline: Prior single-integration differential gates: 648,000 digests across variants (EXP-041), 491,520 (EXP-022), 124,351 per kernel (EXP-039)
entries.measured_result: Batch campaign VERIFIED clean at full predeclared scale (seed 47047, AMD EPYC 9D25): 4,615,011 digests per native backend (v512dual, v512, shani, avx2, c), zero mismatches vs hashlib and pairwise (46,150,110 direct pairwise comparisons; 69,225,165 pairwise relations counting the reference relations). Search campaign FAILED under its predeclared failure rule at its first case: search_first_counted on v512 returned nonce 2083236893 where criterion S-C required the span minimum 2083204125. Root cause is by design in production source: mining/cpu/bal_search.h bal_ctx_publish is first-publisher-wins over bal_partition thread spans, shared by all five native search ABIs, so which genuine hit a multithreaded native search returns is scheduling-dependent. Characterization (1,242 search calls, minimal repro reproducing the exact campaign nonce on call 0): non-minimum genuine returns on all five native backends, always exactly another span's first nonce, eliminated at one thread; zero wrong digests, zero false hits, zero false misses anywhere; batch_search hit sets exact on every executed surface. The minimum-hit invariant is an ESTABLISHED NEGATIVE; cpu and single-threaded search return the minimum. Production impact: none on mining correctness (candidates are independently verified before submission; any genuine hit is a valid candidate). Campaign stopped at the mismatch per its failure rule; production code not modified COMPLETION (2026-11-16, same seed and host, corrected S-C criterion predeclared in EXP047_COMPLETION_REPORT.md: found-flag agreement plus hit genuineness judged, minimum identity recorded as a statistic): the full remaining search ladder executed, 30 cases, 17,694,720 nonces per backend per surface, 390 surface checks, 108 search_first_counted calls, zero found-flag disagreements, zero false hits, zero false misses, zero wrong digests; empty-set agreement at the exact solo density T_SOLO (zero reference hits in 8,388,608 nonces per backend, as expected); boundary first-hit calls returned the named nonces on all six backends. Minimum-identity statistics: cpu 16 of 16 minimum; native backends 6 to 13 of 16 minimum, every non-minimum return a genuine hit. Gate 3 executed as campaign items: G1 to G14 ValueError uniformly on all six engines, G15/G16 refused on all five native backends, zero deviations, PASS. Roll-up: batch VERIFIED, search VERIFIED under the corrected criterion, Gate 3 PASS; the original minimum-identity criterion remains an ESTABLISHED NEGATIVE.
entries.reproduced_by: Not yet independently audited; the divergence itself was reproduced by the author via RAW_RESULTS/minimal_repro.py (exact campaign nonce on call 0) and the characterization campaign

entries.hypothesis: The solo and pool pipelines carry end-to-end non-search overhead of the same order as the GBT pipeline's (tens to a few hundred milliseconds per block) at production difficulty, with the solo path's share handling the largest single stage; the EXP-040 amplified method transfers without modification of production code (portfolio NOVA-ER-0008)
entries.baseline: EXP-040 category F figures for the GBT pipeline (2026-11-15): non-search overhead 43.5 ms empty, 206.3 ms loaded (501 transactions), 49.5 ms amplified; no end-to-end figure existed for the solo or pool pipelines at any difficulty
entries.measured_result: Category F campaign 2026-11-16 (AMD EPYC 9D25, contended single VM, regtest, production share difficulty 0.02, v512dual backend): 136 timed runs, 0 failed, every run exactly one Core-accepted block passing the EXP-036 gate. Non-search overhead medians per block: solo (production SoloServer, vardiff disabled) 97.0 ms empty, 152.4 ms loaded, 115.6 ms amplified (search target divided by 2^2 in the compute proxy; 2^24 on the share target is arithmetically infeasible); pool (production client path against a local harness stub) 55.9 ms empty, 210.7 ms loaded, 97.7 ms amplified; solo with vardiff enabled on production defaults (separately labelled) 89.3 ms with one logged adjustment per session and no measurable overhead. End-to-end medians (search-dominated, geometric): solo 5.280 / 6.046 / 15.334 s, pool 5.068 / 4.087 / 8.829 s. Hypothesis: same-order overheads SUPPORTED; share handling largest stage SUPPORTED broadly (server submit path inside the verdict wait, 58 to 164 ms) and REFUTED narrowly (validate plus EXP-036 verify is only about 2 to 5 ms per share; the mass is the submitblock RPC and chain confirmation); method transfer SUPPORTED with the stated factor adaptation and zero production changes. Counted-hashes accounting probed and recorded: AVX-512 counted attempts are the parallel search's own accounting, not a positional census (first-publisher-wins, consistent with EXP-047). Live miner untouched (share census 589/8 before, 600/8 after).
entries.evidence_limitation: Single contended VM; pool figures are the production client path against a local harness stub doing a real pool's per-block work, not the live public-pool.io pipeline (network latency and pool-side internals unmeasurable from here); vardiff observed over 6-share sessions only; the searched target is the production share difficulty on regtest, so the transferable quantities are the overhead milliseconds, not end-to-end times at mainnet network difficulty

entries.hypothesis: A bounded prefetch queue between the template engine and the search, keyed to the EXP-025 layered identity with a starvation counter, removes most of the prepare-side bubble at template transitions at regtest and solo difficulties; at mainnet difficulty the effect is nil and nothing is claimed there (portfolio NOVA-ER-0011, register R-33)
entries.baseline: Synchronous template resolution in MiningEngine.mine_cycle: every cycle pays the GBT fetch and the full EXP-025 prepare on the critical path before search resumes (EXP-040 priced the loaded stages at GBT 38.0 ms and prepare 19.7 ms of a 206.3 ms non-search overhead per loaded regtest block)
entries.measured_result: New production module mining/prefetch.py (PrefetchQueue, PrefetchFeed) wired into MiningEngine.mine_cycle behind opt-in use_prefetch=False (disabled default byte-for-byte historical, the rollback surface). The feed longpolls and prepares the next template through the EXP-025 cache off the critical path; serve requires the entry's previousblockhash to still be the node's best block and its layered identity, recomputed from scratch, to match the prepared identity, else the entry is dropped (counted by reason) and the cycle falls back synchronously. Gate 3 adversarial suite tests/test_exp051_prefetch.py all passing with ZERO stale serves (identity confusion refused at queue and engine level, stale drop after an external block, superseded, overflow, duplicate, rapid tip changes, disabled default). Gate 4 category F (84 timed runs, 0 failed, all EXP-036 verified, AMD EPYC 9D25 under load 9 to 16): loaded scenario B median non-search overhead 389.7 ms synchronous vs 167.3 ms prefetch (57.1 percent reduction vs the predeclared 15 percent margin, H2 PASS); served fraction in B 1.0 with (gbt + prepare) at 0.0 ms median in served runs (H3 PASS); campaign counters enqueued 62, served 42, starved 6 (the session warm-ups), superseded 16, identity and stale drops 0. Gate 6: queue-served regtest blocks accepted by Core and EXP-036 verified. Inherited suites re-run: test-exp034, test-exp036, test-template-cache, test-exp037, test-mining, test-exp040 all passed; test-engine (intelligence suite, outside the change's import graph) failed three times on its full-sync assertion while external blocks landed on the shared chain, recorded as environment interference.
entries.evidence_limitation: All measurements are the AMD EPYC 9D25 host under heavy contention (load average 9 to 16, a concurrent audit for part of the work); absolute overhead levels are far above EXP-040's quieter-window figures and only the interleaved arm-against-arm comparison carries the verdict. The solo server seam was declared out of scope, not measured.
